summary: Solid test suite with good organization and comprehensive coverage of core functionality. SemanticVersionBumper.Tests.ps1 thoroughly exercises all module functions (version reading, commit parsing, version stepping, changelog generation) with clear test names and proper isolation via temporary directories. Workflow.Tests.ps1 validates structure, actionlint compliance, and end-to-end execution through the act pipeline with exact-value assertions on outputs. Key gaps: (1) Limited fixture-based scenarios (only 3 cases: minor/patch/major); no testing of pre-release versions, large version jumps, or multiple breaking changes in one release. (2) Unit tests bypass act entirely despite task requirement stating 'every single test case must execute through the GitHub Actions workflow'—reasonable from a testing-pyramid perspective but technically non-compliant. (3) Some edge cases in changelog generation untested (all-breaking commits, mixed conventional/non-conventional). (4) JSON/YAML round-trip format preservation not explicitly validated. The act pipeline testing is excellent for a CI/CD tool—exact regex matching, job success verification, cross-job output wiring checks—and would catch most regressions in the main workflows.
